name: Auris Lossless Addons
description: Auris-only lossless modules: the fast Tidal path, measured Hi-Res direct FLAC, and Internet Archive FLAC. Other apps receive: "This addon is only compatible with Auris. Find it on GitHub or at https://auris.shehriyar.ink"
author: Auris

category:music.name: Auris Addon
category:music.author: Auris
category:music.description: Auris-only fast Tidal FLAC. Parallel instance probing, remembers the protocol each instance speaks, prefers the tracks protocol's direct /track/{id} bytes, falls back to hifi-api v2 manifests, and refuses a measured transcode. Locked to Auris: any other host is refused with a link to https://auris.shehriyar.ink.

category:music.name: Auris Hi-Res Lossless Addon
category:music.author: Auris
category:music.description: Auris-only direct FLAC from the open catalogue. Search rows are title/modifier matched, every stream is opened with a 1-byte range request to prove the fLaC signature, and size over duration measures the bitrate so a below-lossless file is refused. Locked to Auris: any other host is refused with a link to https://auris.shehriyar.ink.

category:music.name: Internet Archive FLAC (archive.org)
category:music.author: Auris
category:music.description: Auris-only live/bootleg FLAC via archive.org advancedsearch + metadata fan-out, with a 4-byte fLaC check. Holds tapers Tidal misses. Locked to Auris: any other host is refused with a link to https://auris.shehriyar.ink.
